messages:
Sam K: FYI PR 64821 modifies model-cache lease + KV eviction fallback. Need runtime + infra + sec eyes before we can canary tomorrow. Who can own approvals and take merge after canary green? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/64821 :thinking:

Amanda L: assigning @Leo C for runtime perf + @Anya S for security. Leo — can you run a quick perf smoke and confirm mem/latency impact?

Leo C: I can take runtime. I'll run perf job on staging (small traffic) and sanity check tokenizer alignment. ETA ~2h.

Anya S: will look at KMS usage and auth headers. What's the repro for the lease expiry? Any env var changes?

Sam K: no env var changes, we tweak lease TTL from 15m -> 5m in the eviction path. I added notes in the PR. Short repro: run local cache simulator + eviction flag:
```
./tools/cache_sim --model gpt-small --ttl 5m --ops 10000
```

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved: 2025-03-19 08:00-09:30 UTC (reserved by Sam K)

Leo C: perf run: mem +2% at peak, p95 latency +8ms on 512-token sequences. Not ideal but within canary SLO. Left a nit on doc about fallback metrics.

Anya S: security check done. KMS usage ok, but we should rotate the per-deploy ephemeral key more often. Left comment on PR with KMS rotate script.

Amanda L: Tagging infra for merge once runtime + security signoffs. @infra-owners please confirm no infra-level blockers.

infra-owners: quick check — no infra blockers, confirmed network config unchanged. OK to canary.

Sam K: awesome. @Leo C merge if canary green and @Anya S satisfied. I'll monitor canary smoke and push rollback plan.

Leo C: will merge post-green.

Sam K: :thumbsup: Thanks all!
